scanner-intraorale.title: Intraoral scanner
scanner-intraorale.text: Digital impressions in minutes, with no paste and no gagging. The three-dimensional model of the mouth is available immediately and shared with the laboratory.

radiologia-digitale.title: Digital radiology
radiologia-digitale.text: Intraoral, panoramic and cone beam CT imaging at low dose. Up to 80% less radiation than conventional radiology.

implantologia-guidata.title: Guided implant surgery
implantologia-guidata.text: The procedure is simulated on the patient's CT scan. In theatre, a surgical guide transfers that plan to the millimetre.

microscopia.title: Dental microscopy
microscopia.text: Magnification up to 25×: root canals, margins and fractures become visible. It is what separates treatment that lasts from treatment that has to be redone.

digital-smile-design.title: Digital Smile Design
digital-smile-design.text: The smile is designed on the face before a single tooth is touched. The patient sees, discusses and approves the result in advance.

stampa-3d.title: 3D printing
stampa-3d.text: Models, surgical guides, temporaries and aligners produced in house. Fewer external steps, shorter turnaround.
